subject: Implement multi-user AMC sender → user_id resolution
description:
Wire `config.toml [users]` table parsing (in Settings) and dispatcher resolution: each envelope's `sender_id` is mapped to an internal `user_id` BEFORE the agent runs. Unknown senders are rejected at the dispatcher with a logged warning.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] `Settings.users` is a typed mapping from sender id (e.g. `+15551234567`, `discord:user:123`) to internal `user_id`.
- [ ] The TOML key after `[users.X]` is the literal `user_id` written to every domain table (per §15.3 note).
- [ ] Dispatcher resolves `user_id` from envelope before `agent.run`; rejects unknown senders with logged warning.
- [ ] V1 ships exactly one mapping; adding more is a config edit + restart.
- [ ] No multi-user management UI in V1.

_Edge Cases:_
- [ ] Two senders mapped to the same `user_id`: both routed to the same conversation history (intended).
- [ ] Sender id not in mapping: rejected, no record written.

_Error Handling:_
- [ ] Empty `[users]` table: boot fails with clear error explaining at least one user is required.

**Testing Requirements:**
• Unit: sender → user_id resolution correct for every config'd mapping
• Unit: unknown sender rejected
• Integration: dispatcher writes correct `user_id` to `conversation_history` for the resolved sender

Source: internal/specs/capo-SPEC.md Sections 5.11, 9.1, 15.3
